title: Read your dashboard
summary: The dashboard's cards, charts and activity feed summarize your company's current numbers.

steps.text: Open {dashboard} from the sidebar. The cards at the top show the numbers your company's business type cares about most, such as stock value and receivables.
{quick} underneath the charts jump straight to the lists and reports those numbers come from.
You can also ask the assistant about these figures or recent activity, such as what was sold this week or who changed a record.
